mechanism: Diphenhydramine's anticholinergic properties may reduce captopril's antihypertensive efficacy, and both drugs can cause hypotension; diphenhydramine is metabolized by CYP450 enzymes while captopril may affect renal perfusion.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely when combining these agents; counsel patient on orthostatic hypotension risk and avoid diphenhydramine if alternative antihistamines available; use lowest effective diphenhydramine dose.
